reason: The hypothesis directly restates the results and future work implied by P6, P8, and P21 (annealing a W-based SCCPs HEA to improve ductility while maintaining strength) and combines it with the well-known mechanism of grain-boundary precipitation toughening from P2, P4, P11, and P17. It proposes the same intervention on the same material system as already studied, with only minor specification of a temperature window, making it a restatement of existing findings rather than a new synthesis.
copied_elements: rapid, controlled annealing treatment at intermediate temperature (600-800°C) on a W-based refractory HEA with SCCPs structure
precipitation of a fine, ductile secondary phase at grain boundaries
enhanced ductility and uniform deformability without compromising high strength
mechanism: grain boundary cohesion, dislocation multiplication, strain distribution
